landus-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 48 Landus Cooperative locations across Iowa, Indiana and Minnesota. Iowa carries 46 of them, in towns like Adair, Aredale, Atlantic, Auburn and Bayard, with 1 more at Rushville, Indiana and 1 at Bricelyn, Minnesota. The table carries bids for corn and soybeans.

legacy-coop.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 9 Legacy Coop locations that buy grain, 8 in Nebraska and 1 in South Dakota. The Nebraska elevators include Alliance, Chadron, Gordon, Hay Springs and Hemingford, and the South Dakota stop is Martin. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat.

legacy-farmers-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, the AGSIST network reads cash grain bids at 10 Legacy Farmers Cooperative locations, all of them in Ohio. The list runs through towns like Custar, Defiance, Deshler, Findlay, Fostoria and Mc Comb. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

linn-coop-oil-company.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 5 Linn Coop Oil Company locations, all of them in Iowa. Towns on the list include Alburnett and Cedar Rapids. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot that posts a bid.
